result.rationale: 68-year-old with COPD reporting progressive dyspnea over 2 days now limiting minimal activity (winded walking to bathroom) plus purulent sputum suggests an acute COPD exacerbation, likely infectious. Marked exertional limitation in this context warrants same-day in-person assessment (oxygen saturation, lung exam, possible chest imaging, steroids/antibiotics, and evaluation for respiratory failure) that cannot be accomplished by messaging alone.
